Omnivorous_Speech_Maw.description: The Omnivorous Speech Maw is a grotesque, fleshy organ that melds human lips with an insatiable maw capable of devouring everything from crimson flesh to aquatic bounty and verdant flora. Its paradoxical nature grants the ability to speak fluently while unleashing primal ferocity in unarmed combat.

Goring_Tusked_Maw.description: The Goring Tusked Maw, a fearsome orcish trophy, exudes an aura of primal aggression. Its jagged tusks and gaping maw suggest the brutal strength and ferocity of its boar-like origin.
